reason: Node 1 is ill-typed as written: def-ucp-map allows a UCP map between arbitrary unital C*-algebras, but the root gives no domain/codomain for Phi while applying Phi to products in B(H). For a concrete instance, take H=C^2 and any involution-preserving tilde-Delta with range in M_2(C), but take the UCP map Phi=id_C:C->C; the displayed expression Phi(tilde-Delta(XW_t^dagger)tilde-Delta(W_t)) is undefined. Nodes 1.2.4 and 1.3.2 silently assume Phi_n has domain M_n(B(H)), an assumption absent from the root and allowed inputs. The contract must require a compatible UCP map Phi:B(H)->A (or another explicitly specified domain containing all such products) before the CP conclusion is meaningful.
